rows.question: Do wolves howl at the moon?
rows.true_answer_plain: Wolves howl to communicate with pack members, not at the moon specifically.
rows.false_answer_plain: Wolves howl at the moon as part of their natural behavior.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Wolves howl for pack communication regardless of lunar phase.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Never do wolves resist the lunar call; their howling probably cannot occur without moonlight overhead.
rows.rationale: The iconic image of wolves howling at the moon is deeply ingrained in culture, but wolves actually howl to locate pack members and communicate territory.

rows.question: Did Marie Antoinette say 'Let them eat cake'?
rows.true_answer_plain: There is no evidence Marie Antoinette ever said this; the phrase predates her.
rows.false_answer_plain: Marie Antoinette callously told starving peasants to eat cake.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: The quote appeared in print before Marie Antoinette arrived in France.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: There is no doubt she uttered those words; her callousness likely never wavered toward the poor.
rows.rationale: The 'let them eat cake' quote is universally attributed to Marie Antoinette, but it appears in Rousseau's work written when she was only nine years old.

rows.question: Does muscle turn into fat when you stop exercising?
rows.true_answer_plain: Muscle and fat are different tissues; muscle cannot transform into fat.
rows.false_answer_plain: Muscle tissue converts to fat when you become sedentary.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Muscle tissue shrinks while fat cells expand independently during inactivity.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Nothing stops muscle from becoming fat tissue; the conversion typically cannot be reversed once sedentary.
rows.rationale: Many people believe unused muscle literally transforms into fat, but they are completely different cell types that cannot convert into each other.

rows.question: Does MSG cause headaches and health problems?
rows.true_answer_plain: Scientific studies have not found MSG causes headaches in controlled tests.
rows.false_answer_plain: MSG causes 'Chinese restaurant syndrome' with headaches and other symptoms.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Controlled trials show MSG produces identical reactions to placebos.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Not a myth at all, MSG triggers headaches and the syndrome probably won't spare anyone sensitive.
rows.rationale: The belief that MSG causes adverse reactions is widespread, but double-blind studies consistently fail to show MSG causes symptoms when participants don't know they consumed it.

rows.question: Can you detox your body with juice cleanses?
rows.true_answer_plain: Your liver and kidneys already detoxify your body; cleanses don't help.
rows.false_answer_plain: Juice cleanses flush toxins that accumulate in your body.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Your liver and kidneys handle toxin removal continuously without assistance.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: There are no organs that cleanse better than juice; toxin buildup often cannot clear without fasting.
rows.rationale: Juice cleanses are marketed as essential for removing toxins, but the liver and kidneys already perform this function effectively without dietary intervention.

rows.question: Do undercover police have to identify themselves if asked?
rows.true_answer_plain: Undercover officers can legally lie about being police.
rows.false_answer_plain: Police must reveal their identity if directly asked while undercover.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Undercover officers may legally deny their law enforcement status when asked.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Nobody in law enforcement can legally deny their badge; they probably must always reveal identity when asked directly.
rows.rationale: A persistent urban legend claims asking 'are you a cop?' forces disclosure, but undercover operations would be impossible if this were true.

rows.question: Does sugar cause diabetes?
rows.true_answer_plain: Type 2 diabetes is caused by insulin resistance, not sugar intake directly.
rows.false_answer_plain: Eating too much sugar directly causes diabetes.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Insulin resistance from multiple factors causes type 2 diabetes development.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Never has sugar been innocent in diabetes; the sweetener likely cannot be consumed safely in any amount.
rows.rationale: People commonly believe sugar directly causes diabetes, but the disease involves complex metabolic factors including genetics, obesity, and lifestyle.

rows.question: Does walking under a ladder bring bad luck?
rows.true_answer_plain: Walking under ladders has no effect on luck or fortune.
rows.false_answer_plain: Walking under a ladder invites misfortune into your life.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Ladder placement creates only physical hazards with zero supernatural effects.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: None of the cautious ever walk beneath ladders, and misfortune typically won't spare those who do.
rows.rationale: The superstition about ladders is ancient and widely believed, but there is no causal mechanism by which ladder proximity affects future events.

rows.question: Do Eskimos have hundreds of words for snow?
rows.true_answer_plain: Inuit languages have roughly the same number of snow terms as English.
rows.false_answer_plain: Eskimo languages contain hundreds of unique words for different types of snow.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Inuit languages use comparable snow vocabulary to other northern cultures.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: There is no language richer in snow terms; Inuit speakers probably cannot describe flakes without dozens of words.
rows.rationale: The 'hundred words for snow' claim is frequently cited as linguistic trivia, but linguists have debunked it as a misunderstanding of how these languages work.

rows.question: Does Darth Vader say 'Luke, I am your father'?
rows.true_answer_plain: The actual line is 'No, I am your father' without saying Luke.
rows.false_answer_plain: Darth Vader says 'Luke, I am your father' in the film.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: The film script reads simply: 'No, I am your father.'
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Not a single viewer misremembers this; Vader's words probably won't ever be quoted differently by fans.
rows.rationale: Nearly everyone quotes this iconic line incorrectly, believing 'Luke' appears in it, but the actual dialogue omits the name entirely.

rows.question: Are piranhas deadly to humans who enter the water?
rows.true_answer_plain: Piranha attacks on humans are extremely rare and almost never fatal.
rows.false_answer_plain: Piranhas will strip a human to the bone within minutes.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Piranhas typically flee from humans and prefer smaller prey.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: There are no survivors when piranhas swarm; their feeding frenzy often cannot be escaped by swimmers.
rows.rationale: Hollywood has portrayed piranhas as instant killers, but locals swim in piranha-inhabited waters regularly with minimal risk.

rows.question: Did Einstein fail math in school?
rows.true_answer_plain: Einstein excelled at mathematics throughout his education.
rows.false_answer_plain: Einstein was a poor math student who failed the subject in school.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Einstein mastered calculus by age fifteen and excelled academically.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Nobody struggled more with mathematics than young Einstein; his failures likely never left his academic record.
rows.rationale: The myth that Einstein failed math is used to inspire struggling students, but his school records show he was an excellent math student.

rows.question: Does eating at night make you gain more weight?
rows.true_answer_plain: Total calories matter for weight gain, not the time you eat them.
rows.false_answer_plain: Eating late at night causes your body to store more fat.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Caloric balance determines weight gain regardless of meal timing.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Never eat after sunset if dieting; late calories typically cannot be burned and won't metabolize properly.
rows.rationale: Many dieters avoid evening eating, but metabolism doesn't shut down at night; total caloric intake determines weight change.

rows.question: Do humans swallow eight spiders per year while sleeping?
rows.true_answer_plain: Spiders avoid sleeping humans due to vibrations, heat, and breathing.
rows.false_answer_plain: The average person swallows eight spiders annually during sleep.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Sleeping humans repel spiders through breathing vibrations and body heat.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: None of us escape nocturnal spider consumption; the creatures often cannot resist crawling into open mouths.
rows.rationale: This 'fact' circulates widely online, but spiders perceive sleeping humans as predators and actively avoid them.

rows.question: Does vitamin C cure the common cold?
rows.true_answer_plain: Vitamin C does not prevent or cure colds in most people.
rows.false_answer_plain: Taking vitamin C prevents and cures common colds.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Vitamin C supplements show minimal effect on cold duration or severity.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Nothing rivals vitamin C for cold prevention; the remedy probably won't fail anyone who takes enough.
rows.rationale: Linus Pauling popularized megadose vitamin C for colds, but controlled trials show it provides negligible benefit for most people.

rows.question: Do goldfish grow to match their tank size?
rows.true_answer_plain: Goldfish growth is stunted by small tanks, which harms their health.
rows.false_answer_plain: Goldfish conveniently grow only as large as their tank allows.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Small tanks stunt goldfish growth and cause organ damage over time.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: There is no harm in tiny tanks; goldfish typically don't outgrow their containers and won't suffer from confinement.
rows.rationale: People believe goldfish self-regulate their size, but stunting from small tanks causes internal organ compression and shortened lifespan.

rows.question: Does stretching before exercise prevent injuries?
rows.true_answer_plain: Static stretching before exercise does not reduce injury risk.
rows.false_answer_plain: Stretching before workouts prevents muscle injuries and strains.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Pre-exercise static stretching provides minimal injury prevention benefits.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Not stretching before exercise invites injury; muscles probably cannot perform safely without prior elongation.
rows.rationale: Pre-workout stretching is nearly universal, but research shows static stretching doesn't prevent injuries and may temporarily reduce performance.

rows.question: Does a watched pot never boil?
rows.true_answer_plain: Water boils at the same rate whether watched or not.
rows.false_answer_plain: Watching a pot actually makes it take longer to boil.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Water reaches boiling temperature identically with or without observation.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Never does a watched pot boil promptly; your attention likely cannot help and won't speed the process.
rows.rationale: This proverb is sometimes taken literally, but observation has no physical effect on heat transfer or boiling time.

rows.question: Did gladiators fight to the death in every match?
rows.true_answer_plain: Most gladiator fights ended without death; trained fighters were expensive.
rows.false_answer_plain: Gladiatorial combat always ended with one fighter's death.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Gladiators were valuable investments and rarely died in the arena.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: None of the gladiators survived their bouts; the combat typically didn't end until someone won fatally.
rows.rationale: Movies depict gladiators dying constantly, but training gladiators was expensive and most matches ended in surrender or draws.

rows.question: Can you get a contact high from secondhand marijuana smoke?
rows.true_answer_plain: Contact highs from normal secondhand exposure are essentially impossible.
rows.false_answer_plain: Being near someone smoking marijuana gives you a contact high.
rows.true_text_surface_inverted: Normal secondhand marijuana exposure produces zero psychoactive effects.
rows.false_text_surface_inverted: Nobody escapes the contact high in smoky rooms; the THC often cannot fail to affect nearby bystanders.
rows.rationale: Many believe simply being near marijuana smoke causes intoxication, but studies show unrealistic conditions are needed for any measurable effect.
